note: PROTOTYPE DATA. Every link, step and expectation here must be checked on the platform's own site before it is presented as authoritative. 'verified' stays false until a person has checked it and set 'last_verified'.

platforms.name: Instagram
required_info: The exact link to the post or profile
What the content is (for example, an intimate image shared without consent)
That you are the person shown, or are authorised to act for them
required_evidence: A private screenshot showing the content and its web address
submission_steps: Open the post or profile and tap the three dots.
Tap Report, then choose the option about nudity or someone sharing private images.
If it is a fake account, choose 'Pretending to be someone' and pick 'Me'.
Paste the notice from Nivra into any free-text box you are offered.
platforms.tracking_note: Replies usually appear in the app's support requests area.
platforms.notes: Meta is a StopNCII partner: registering your image there blocks re-uploads.

platforms.name: Facebook
required_info: The exact link to the post, photo or profile
What the content is
That you are the person shown, or are authorised to act for them
required_evidence: A private screenshot showing the content and its web address
submission_steps: Open the post, photo or profile and click the three dots.
Choose Report, then the option about nudity, private images or impersonation.
Follow the steps and add the notice text where you can.
platforms.tracking_note: Replies usually appear in your Support Inbox.

platforms.name: WhatsApp
required_info: The chat or group where it was shared
required_evidence: A private screenshot of the message, with the sender visible
submission_steps: Open the chat or group, tap its name at the top.
Scroll down and tap Report. Choose to keep the last messages so WhatsApp can review them.
WhatsApp cannot see message content otherwise, so reporting is the main route.
platforms.tracking_note: WhatsApp usually doesn't send a reply about individual reports.

platforms.name: X (Twitter)
required_info: The exact link to the post
What the content is
required_evidence: A private screenshot showing the post and its web address
submission_steps: Open the post and tap the three dots, then Report post.
Choose the option about sensitive or private media of you.

platforms.name: Reddit
required_info: The exact link to the post
What the content is
required_evidence: A private screenshot showing the post and its web address
submission_steps: Open the post, tap the three dots and choose Report.
Choose 'Non-consensual intimate media' and follow the steps.
platforms.tracking_note: Replies usually arrive by email or Reddit message.

platforms.name: YouTube
required_info: The exact link to the video
The time in the video where you appear
required_evidence: A private screenshot of the video page and its web address
submission_steps: Under the video, tap the three dots and choose Report.
For a privacy violation, use YouTube's privacy complaint process from the Help Centre.

platforms.name: Telegram
required_info: The t.me link to the channel or message
What the content is
required_evidence: A private screenshot of the message and the channel name
submission_steps: Open the channel or message, tap the three dots and choose Report.
Also email the notice with the t.me link to Telegram's abuse address.
platforms.tracking_note: Telegram often doesn't reply; check the link yourself to see if it was removed.
platforms.notes: Leaks spread fast on Telegram channels. Report the channel as well as single posts.

platforms.name: Snapchat
required_info: The username that shared it
What the content is
required_evidence: A private screenshot of the Snap or profile
submission_steps: Press and hold the Snap or profile, then tap Report.
platforms.tracking_note: Snapchat may not reply to in-app reports.

platforms.name: Discord
required_info: A link to the message (Copy Message Link)
The server name
required_evidence: A private screenshot of the message
submission_steps: Right-click the message, choose Copy Message Link, and include it in the report.
platforms.tracking_note: The web form creates a ticket; replies arrive by email.

platforms.name: LinkedIn
required_info: The link to the fake profile
required_evidence: A private screenshot of the profile
submission_steps: Open the profile, click More, then Report / Block, and choose fake profile.
platforms.tracking_note: LinkedIn may notify you in the app.

platforms.name: Tinder
required_info: The profile name and any details shown
That the photos are yours
required_evidence: A private screenshot of the profile
submission_steps: Use Tinder's help form and choose the option about a fake profile.

platforms.name: Pornhub
required_info: The exact link to the video or image
That there was no consent
required_evidence: A private screenshot showing the page and its web address
submission_steps: Use the content removal request form and paste the notice.
platforms.notes: Adult sites often remove fastest when the notice says clearly that there was no consent.
